## Reusable rules

1. **Represent open-ended known string codes with extensible unions** When a field has documented known string codes but must accept future or unknown codes, model it as a union that retains a string variant. *Scope:* TypeSpec string-code fields that need both known values and forward compatibility. *Inferred lesson.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46316, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/90e21e828b2dadd5978656ba1d0329434975794a/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/voice-agents/models.tsp

2. **Give distinct reason domains distinct types and context** Separate lifecycle-event, single-call, and overall-job reasons so their meanings and evolution remain distinguishable; document context-specific interpretation rather than implying identical outcomes. *Scope:* Reason-code models where event, individual-operation, and aggregate-job outcomes differ. *Inferred lesson.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46316, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/90e21e828b2dadd5978656ba1d0329434975794a/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/voice-agents/models.tsp

3. **Preserve existing property constraints when changing its type** The patch retains optionality and existing length constraints while replacing plain-string reason fields with unions; preserve established property constraints unless a separate change justifies altering them. *Scope:* TypeSpec changes that replace a property's primitive type with a union. *Inferred lesson.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46316, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/90e21e828b2dadd5978656ba1d0329434975794a/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/voice-agents/models.tsp
